description: NaScSi₂O₆ is Esseneite structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.50 Å. Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.23 Å. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent ScO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 31-58°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.67 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Si atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Sc, and one Si atom.
